title: celtis occidentalis f. canina
intro: Celtis occidentalis f. canina, commonly known as the American hackberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Celtis genus. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Celtis occidentalis f. canina include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
